modules.name: Just Fiends
modules.description: Six linked slopes: envelopes, LFOs and oscillators that share one Time, spread by Intone. Every mode and Run mode is labelled, and a display shows all six shapes

modules.name: Weird Sisters
modules.description: Three linked filters (low, centre, high) around one frequency: crossover or formant, with resonance or anti-resonance. A display draws all three responses

modules.name: Mangrave
modules.description: A formant oscillator: a square core fires bursts of a second wave, shaped by Formant, Barrel and Air. A scope shows the core, the bursts and their envelope
